errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does not have a visible scale with intervals or numbers. The values are shown as data labels directly on the bars, not as part of an axis scale.
The three categories on the vertical axis are not arranged in any apparent ascending order; their placement seems arbitrary.
The color for the "Много по-труден" category is a light blue/teal, not dark blue ("тъмносиньо"). The darker blue color corresponds to the "Много по-лесен" category.
The description fails to mention that in the category group "...за жените, отколкото за мъжете", the bar for "Много по-труден" is missing because its value is 0.
